label: STRIDE routes
info:
Tells the treadmill which .gpx files are in www/treadmill/routes.

Two ways, and you only need one — see docs/ROUTE_MAP.md in the STRIDE
repo. Both send a bare JSON array of filenames, which is the format
the console's 'List file' setting expects.

A) LIVE ENDPOINT. The console asks Node-RED directly, so nothing is
   stored and nothing can be out of date. Console setting:
       List file = http://<home-assistant>:1880/stride-routes
   Needs the add-on's port 1880 reachable on your network.

B) WRITES index.json. A file beside the .gpx files, rewritten every
   five minutes and on start. Needs no exposed port. Console setting:
       List file = index.json   (the default)
   Slightly behind reality rather than live, which was never the
   problem: the bug this replaces was a human forgetting to run a
   script for weeks, not a file being ninety seconds old.

Delete whichever flow you are not using.
